walls.label: UNCROSSABLE-D

verdict_strict: G7 KILLED — W10 (S1) alone discharges the kill condition: provably distinct configurations, provably identical in-channel, no instrument upgrade crosses it. W11/W12/W13/W15/W16 corroborate.
